units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:2">Sabb. I, 2</cite> <he>ואם הִתְחִילוּ וכ׳</he> but if they have commenced (doing so), they need not discontinue.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:3">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>כל מי שהוא מַתְחִיל במצוה וכ׳</he> he that begins a good deed and does not finish it &c.; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 8">Deut. R. s. 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 8">Ib.</cite> <he>משה ה׳ וכ׳</he> Moses began a good deed when he took Joseph’s bones with him.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> <he>ה׳ הקב״ה לברכך</he> the Lord has begun to bless thee (by giving thee a daughter); a. v. fr.
